notes.title: Welcome to Merana and the Cubewalker on Steam - wishlist now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Nice to see you here and happy to take you along on my journey to the game's release. 

The game ‘[b]Merana and the Cubewalker[/b]’ now has an official [b]Steam page[/b]!
A playable [b]demo[/b] is currently available on Itch.io for you to try out.

I hope to see you on the community hub or discord!

Greetings,
Tony
